title: Intermittent fasting vs. calorie restriction: which actually ...
snippet: Sep 7, 2026 · A 2023 meta-analysis in Nutrients of seven randomized trials with 458 participants found that time-restricted eating combined with a calorie deficit produced 2.11 kg more weight loss than calorie restriction alone. Improvements in blood glucose and lipids, however, came primarily from the calorie deficit itself, not the timing.

title: Review Finds Intermittent Fasting Matches Calorie Cutting on ...
snippet: 14 hours ago · Key results On weight, the review leans on a network meta-analysis of 99 randomized trials which found most fasting regimens produced weight loss comparable to continuous energy restriction at 24 weeks or longer. Across the four patterns, typical reductions ranged from roughly 1.5 kg for time-restricted feeding to 7.7 kg for 4:3, varying with duration and adherence.
